Treatment D = post_pri = 1 from the fund's first post-signing quarter (absorbing in calendar time, verified); gvar = gpost. fixest (fixef.rm = none) reproduces the log: coef 0.1476646 vs 0.1476646, N 3662 vs 3662, clusters 478 vs 478, SE 0.2557661 vs 0.2557661. Regression sample: N = 3662, 478 funds, 35 consecutive quarters. Cohorts (first post-signing quarter): 34, of which 30 have both treated and untreated rows in the sample. In 34 of the 35 treated periods another cohort supplies untreated rows (not-yet-signed funds; no never-treated funds). Funds observed only after signing in the sample (always-treated within sample): 248 (32.1% of rows); funds observed only before signing: 20.
